headline: Israel seeks to jail Palestinian student activist without trial after dorm arrest
label: NEWS
caption:
Protests erupted in Jerusalem following the arrest of a Palestinian student activist by Israeli authorities. 👆

According to The Guardian, Israel is seeking to jail the activist without trial following a raid and arrest at a dorm.

Arab News reported that demonstrations quickly followed the detention, drawing crowds to the streets in protest.

How should authorities handle student activism and security measures during ongoing tensions? 👇
